page.layout: Two columns of a table under a title; each line holds a left-hand and a right-hand entry with page numbers. Title and subtitle full width at top. Letters A, B and C stand as headings within the columns. A small mark at the foot, centre, and a cut-off line "Cali-" at the bottom right.

main_text.head: CATALOGVS ROMANORVM Pontificum iuxta Alphabeticum ordinem.

page.notes: The table is printed in two parallel columns, and the number placements for Alexander quartus/quintus/sextus and Benedictus undecimus/duodecimus are hard to assign with certainty; they are copied as they lie on the line. "Benedictus decimusterti-us" is broken across two lines at a printed hyphen. A small "x"-like mark with an underline sits at the foot, centre; it is not transcribed as text. The last line is cut off by the page edge after "Cali-", and the continuation is not visible on this scan. The Roman numeral for Calixtus primus's entry and the octauus number are doubtful.
